title: Ledger Entry Schema
description: Single entry in the immutable hash-chain ledger (D11). Append-only. Tamper-evident via prev_hash chain.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the previous entry's entry_hash. 'GENESIS' for index 0.

entry_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of this entry's canonical fields (excluding entry_hash itself)

type.description: 'seal' closes a chain segment: the final entry written before the file is archived and a fresh segment starts. Exists because a poisoned entry (pre-b730629 doubling bug) is permanent once written -- the honest way out is to close the segment around it, never to rewrite history.

payload_ref.description: Path to the evidence bundle or detailed payload for this entry

prev_segment.description: On a genesis entry only: filename of the sealed segment this chain continues from (e.g. chain-001.jsonl). Together with prev_segment_head it keeps continuity ACROSS files: an auditor verifies the named archive's seal entry hash equals prev_segment_head, so rotating segments never becomes a way to quietly drop history.

prev_segment_head.description: On a genesis entry only: entry_hash of the sealed segment's final (seal) entry. See prev_segment.

per_agent_cost_usd.description: Cost attributable to the agent that produced this entry. Optional: an entry written by a hook has no model call behind it and must stay valid without this.

token_count.description: Total tokens for the call behind this entry (in + out)

model_id.description: Concrete model that produced this entry, e.g. claude-opus-4-8. Free string, not an enum: a project on a different vendor's ladder must be able to record its own ids honestly rather than be forced into this repo's.

stage_id.description: Workflow stage this entry belongs to, so cost and decisions can be attributed per stage of the DAG
